description: The chart illustrates the number of datasets by language from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled from 2012 to 2022 in a linear sequence. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, and 10^2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a year and containing bars for different languages, including "All other" (orange), "Arabic" (green), "Bengali" (red), "Spanish" (purple), and "Russian" (brown), as well as a blue bar representing an unspecified language. The bars are generally sorted in no particular order within each group. For the years 2012 to 2015, only the blue bar is present, with values ranging from approximately 1 to 3. From 2016 onwards, the number of datasets for various languages increases, with the blue bar consistently being the tallest, reaching a maximum value of around 80 in 2021. The orange bar ("All other") is also prominent, with values ranging from around 3 in 2016 to 70 in 2020. Other languages, such as Arabic, Spanish, and Russian, have varying numbers of datasets across the years, with some years having no datasets for certain languages. The chart does not display any specific visual emphasis on particular bars.
